ideas.pitch: A developer tool and live visualization overlay designed to track typing mechanics, backspace frequency, and paste attempts for anti-cheat verification in 1v1 coding duels.
ideas.title: TypeLock Telemetry Studio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds core infrastructure for the tournament's unique anti-cheat and real-time telemetry constraints, making it appealing to the event organizers.

ideas.pitch: An automated casting companion that ingests live match telemetry from competitive programming duels and generates text commentary feeds or timestamped highlights for YouTube VODs.
ideas.title: SpectatorVOD Caster Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly enhances the esports broadcast and VOD production value emphasized in the hackathon overview.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight, secure multi-language code execution sandbox optimized for sub-second test case feedback loops in rapid 1v1 coding battles.
ideas.title: DuetSandbox Code Execution Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the core technical requirement of instant test case progress bars and reliable execution across C++, Python, Java, and JavaScript under strict time limits.

ideas.pitch: A client-side browser extension that logs keystroke timings and detects clipboard bypass anomalies to enforce pure manual execution rules in competitive coding duels.
ideas.title: KbdRhythm Anti-Cheat Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the tournament's primary rule twist (pure manual execution and no copy-pasting) with a dedicated engineering solution.

ideas.pitch: A real-time single-elimination tournament bracket manager featuring synchronized countdown timers, live test case progress telemetry, and instant advancement triggers for 16 players.
ideas.title: MatchTree 1v1 Bracket Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides the exact operational software needed to run the 16-player single-elimination tournament smoothly.
